title: Weather stations: online weather of any place, for the analysis and the runs
intro: The section Online weather of a place, at the foot of Weather stations, finds a place by name, reads its daily weather of the years you choose from the internet (Open-Meteo, ERA5 reanalysis) and then offers three uses: the weather of the SWAFL project, the weather of every Daisy run, and a log in the list of the plots. The same record is therefore used in the analysis of the project, in the Daisy runs and in the figures.

marks.d: A town, a village or a farm name; the name is searched on the internet.
Lists the places of that name; choose one and the latitude and longitude are filled.
First year of the record to read.
Last complete year; the current year is not complete yet.
Reads the daily rain, temperature and radiation and checks them.
Sets the record as the weather of the SWAFL project, so every layer of the project uses it.
Sets the record as the weather of every simulation of Scenarios, Experiments and Processes.

marks.t: Add to the list of logs
marks.d: Adds the record to the logs, so that it can be drawn in Plot.
